name: How long does a typical architectural millwork installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical architectural millwork installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an architectural millwork installation project varies significantly based on its complexity, size, and the types of materials involved. A small, straightforward project, like installing a few custom shelves, might take a few days, while a large-scale project involving multiple rooms with intricate built-ins could span several weeks or even months. The timeline also depends on the lead time for custom fabrication and the coordination with other trades on-site. We provide a detailed project schedule after initial design and material selections are finalized, outlining key milestones and expected completion dates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on complexity, size, and materials; small projects can take days, while large ones may take weeks or months.
